en.title: Matthew McConaughey Reveals Why He Turned Down The Last of Us Role
en.summary: Matthew McConaughey has confirmed he seriously considered playing Joel Miller in HBO's "The Last of Us" before ultimately passing on the Emmy-nominated role. The acclaimed actor explained his decision stemmed from a personal period of recalibration and a reluctance for long-term TV commitments.
en.body:
The world of television adaptations often presents intriguing casting 'what ifs,' and one of the most discussed has been who almost played Joel Miller in HBO's critically acclaimed series, **The Last of Us**. Actor **Matthew McConaughey** has now confirmed that he was indeed in serious contention for the role, even speaking with showrunner **Craig Mazin** about the possibility.

During a recent appearance on the Happy Sad Confused podcast, McConaughey revealed that while the offer was compelling, it ultimately wasn't the right fit for him at that specific moment in his career. He explained that he was in a phase where he was "not really acting at that point," but rather focusing on writing and exploring "leadership roles in life." Despite this personal focus, the project itself held significant appeal. "It was really good, I was really excited," McConaughey admitted.

McConaughey's hesitation also seems to stem from his profound experience with **True Detective**, a series that redefined prestige television for many and involved a significant commitment. He noted the difficulty of convincing actors like himself and **Woody Harrelson** to take on TV series roles during that era. "We pulled off a real coup with True Detective, at a time when [TV] series were not something that actors like myself or Woody Harrelson would hop over and go do," he recalled. He acknowledged that **The Last of Us** was a "really good" project, but stated, "it just wasn't for me at the time. I don't know what would have been for me at the time." The potential for a long-running, multi-year commitment, which is standard for successful television shows, also factored into his decision, though he wryly noted that Joel's fate in the source material might have mitigated that concern.

## Casting Near Misses and Fan Reactions

The revelation has sparked considerable discussion among fans of both the game and the HBO series. While **Pedro Pascal** has earned widespread praise for his nuanced portrayal of Joel, embodying the character's gruff exterior and underlying vulnerability, it's natural for fans to wonder how McConaughey's unique presence might have shaped the character. His distinctive drawl and intensity are undeniable, and imagining him navigating the brutal post-apocalyptic landscape alongside Ellie offers a fascinating alternate vision. However, the overwhelming consensus from viewers and critics alike is that **Pedro Pascal** *is* Joel Miller, delivering a performance that has become as iconic as the game's original protagonist.

## What's Next for The Last of Us

HBO's **The Last of Us** premiered in 2023 to massive critical and commercial success. Filming for the second season, which will adapt events from **The Last of Us Part II**, is reportedly underway, with **Damon Lindelof** and **Jonathan E. Steinberg** serving as showrunners alongside **Craig Mazin**. Fans eagerly await further details on the new season's release date and the full scope of its narrative.

tr.title: Matthew McConaughey, The Last of Us'taki Joel Miller Rolünü Neden Reddetti?
tr.summary: Matthew McConaughey, HBO'nun kritik başarıya ulaşan dizisi The Last of Us'ta Joel Miller olarak oynama teklifini neden reddettiğini açıkladı. McConaughey, kişisel olarak bir yeniden değerlendirme sürecinde olduğunu ve uzun süreli TV taahhütlerine karşı isteksiz olduğunu belirtti.
tr.body:
## Matthew McConaughey'nin Kararı
Televizyon adaptasyonlarının dünyası often ilginç casting 'neyin olabileceği' senaryolarını sunar ve bunlardan biri de HBO'nun kritik başarıya ulaşan dizisi The Last of Us'ta Joel Miller olarak kimin oynayabileceği idi. Matthew McConaughey, bu rol için ciddi olarak düşünüldüğünü ve showrunner Craig Mazin ile konuşduğunu doğruladı.

McConaughey, Happy Sad Confused podcast'ine yaptığı recent bir görünümde, teklifin cezbedici olduğunu ancak o anda kariyerinde doğru olmadığı söyledi. O, 'o noktada gerçekten aktör değilim' dedi ve yazmaya ve 'hayatın liderlik rollerini' keşfetmeye odaklandığını belirtti. Buna rağmen, proje itself önemli bir çekiciliğe sahipti. 'Gerçekten iyi, çok heyecanlandım' dedi.

McConaughey'nin tereddütü, aynı zamanda **True Detective** deneyimiyle ilgili görünüyor. Bu dizi, birçok kişi için prestijli televizyonun tanımını değiştirdi ve önemli bir taahhüt gerektiriyordu. O, **Woody Harrelson** gibi aktörlerin o dönemde TV dizileri rollerini üstlenmesinin zorluğunu hatırlattı. 'True Detective ile gerçek bir başarıya imza attık, o zamanlar [TV] dizileri, benim gibi veya Woody Harrelson gibi aktörlerin atlayıp yapacağı bir şey değildi' dedi. **The Last of Us**'un 'gerçekten iyi' bir proje olduğunu kabul etti, ancak 'o zaman için bana uygun değildi. O zaman için neyin uygun olacağını bilmiyorum' dedi. Başarılı televizyon şovlarının standardı olan uzun süreli, çok yıllı bir taahhüt olasılığı da kararına etki etti, ancak Joel'in kaderinin kaynak materyalde bu endişeyi hafifletebileceğini belirtti.

## Casting Yaklaşımları ve Hayran Tepkileri
Bu açıklama, hem oyun hem de HBO dizisinin hayranları arasında önemli bir tartışmaya neden oldu. **Pedro Pascal**, Joel'in karmaşık karakterini canlandırmasıyla geniş çapta övgü aldı, ancak McConaughey'nin benzersiz varlığıyla karakteri nasıl şekillendirebileceği konusunda doğal bir merak oluştu. Onun ayırt edici aksanı ve yoğunluğu inkar edilemez ve Ellie ile birlikte zorlu bir post-apokaliptik manzarayı gezmesi, ilginç bir alternatif vizyon sunuyor. Ancak, izleyiciler ve eleştirmenler arasında baskın bir fikir, **Pedro Pascal**'in *Joel Miller* olduğu ve oyunun orijinal protagonisti kadar ikonik bir performans sunduğu yönünde.

## The Last of Us'un Geleceği
HBO'nun **The Last of Us** dizisi, 2023'te büyük bir kritik ve ticari başarıyla yayınlandı. İkinci sezonun, **The Last of Us Part II**'den olayları adapte edeceği ve **Damon Lindelof** ile **Jonathan E. Steinberg**'in **Craig Mazin**'le birlikte showrunner olarak görev yapacakları bildiriliyor. Hayranlar, yeni sezonun yayın tarihini ve hikayesinin tam kapsamını öğrenmek için sabırsızlanıyor.

content_raw: On an August 13 episode of the Happy Sad Confused podcast, actor Matthew McConaughey spoke about almost playing Joel in HBO's The Last of Us TV series, and why he ultimately turned down the role. McConaughey said he was in contact with showrunner Craig Mazin about playing the part, and that he seriously considered taking it up. "I wasn't really acting at that point," McConaughey explained. "I was doing more writing and looking at leadership roles in life." Even with that caveat he was still tempted: "It was really good, I was really excited." At least part of the problem seems to have been that Mazin had a tough act to follow: McConaughey is a prolific Hollywood actor, and has lent his voice to TV animation here and there, but his only lead role on a TV series? The legendary first season of Nic Pizzolatto's noir anthology, True Detective. "We pulled off a real coup with True Detective, at a time when [TV] series were not something that actors like myself or Woody Harrelson would hop over and go do," said McConaughey. "That one succeeded in a real fashion. Last of Us was really good, it just wasn't for me at the time. I don't know what would have been for me at the time." McConaughey also expressed trepidation over the potential long-term commitment required by a successful TV show: "In success, this is something you'll be doing for years and years and years." Maybe not so much with Joel in The Last of Us, given, uh, spoilers. The role likely still demands an obligation through flashbacks and the like, though. True Detective S1 made me a McConaughey sardaukar for life, but even for me, him passing on this role doesn't seem like a great loss for human flourishing.
